+package main
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"flag"
+	"log"
+	"os"
+
+	"go.flipt.io/flipt/internal/oci"
+	"go.uber.org/zap"
+)
+
+func main() {
+	testdata := flag.String("testdata-dir", "", "directory of feature documents")
+	bundles := flag.String("bundles-dir", "", "bundle output directory")
+	flag.Parse()
+
+	ref, err := oci.ParseReference("flipt://local/features:latest")
+	if err != nil {
+		log.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	store, err := oci.NewStore(zap.NewNop(), *bundles)
+	if err != nil {
+		log.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := os.MkdirAll(*bundles, 0755); err != nil {
+		log.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err := store.Build(context.Background(), os.DirFS(*testdata), ref); err != nil {
+		log.Fatal(err)
+	}
+}
